<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Reopen a closed load (create a reopening)"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/loads/{loadId}/reopenings"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Moves a `CLOSED` load back to `LOADING` and publishes `LoadReopened`
so yard-management reopens the door work. A `SHIP_CONFIRMED` load
never changes: `409 load-confirmed` (`ErrLoadConfirmed`).

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
